easyPrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Brash Taunter.
description:
Deal damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter and Blazing Sunsteel trigger.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing damage to any opponent.
Resolve the Blazing Sunsteel trigger, dealing damage to Brash Taunter.
Repeat from step 2.
